  predlogi.

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI HIKOYaDA.

  to stop AT a place
     - joyda to'xtamoq
  to rock FROM side TO side
     - u yoqdan-bu yoqqa chayqalmoq
  IN the distance
     - uzoqda
  except FOR sb
     - kimdandir tashqari
  IN search OF sth
     - biror narsani qidirib
  to search FOR sth
     - biror narsani qidirmoq
  IN the end (= finally)
     - oxir-oqibat
  ON an island

  to benefit FROM sth

  predloglar BOShQA.

  ⚠ 'on the island', 'on Cyprus'.


⚠ 'IN THE END' va 'AT THE END':

  in the end = oxir-oqibat, nihoyat
  at the end of = ... ning oxirida
     ('at the end of the film')
  ⚠ ADAShTIRMANG!

exercises.instructionEn: The Giant Squid

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI.


⚠ 8-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - HIKOYaDA:

  PAST SIMPLE (asosiy voqealar):
    said, gave, stopped, prepared,
    began, curled, lifted, started,
    appeared, disappeared, reached,
    told, searched, found, became

  PAST PERFECT (undan OLDIN bo'lgan):
    'he HAD never SEEN it himself'
    'He HAD just CAST his fishing
     line when ...'
    'couldn't believe what HAD
     HAPPENED'
    'a scientist who HAD SPENT most
     of her life'
    'the only one who HAD BENEFITTED'

  USED TO (o'tmishdagi odat):
    'He USED TO tell the tourists
     exciting stories'

  ⚠ Keyingi betlarda tushuntiriladi.


⚠ 'KAIKOURA':

  Yangi Zelandiyadagi joy - kitlarni
  kuzatish bilan mashhur.
  ⚠ Kitobda 'island' deyilgan, aslida
  yarim orol.


⚠ 'ARCHITEUTHIS':

  Ulkan kalmarning lotincha ilmiy
  nomi.

tasks.en: The Giant Squid
tasks.uz: Ulkan kalmar

tasks.en: "Kaikoura is New Zealand's most beautiful island," Jim Banning said to the latest group of tourists. "You can often see whales here, too, swimming near the shore."
tasks.uz: "Kaikoura - Yangi Zelandiyaning eng go'zal oroli, - dedi Jim Banning navbatdagi turistlar guruhiga. - Bu yerda qirg'oq yaqinida suzayotgan kitlarni ham tez-tez ko'rish mumkin".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'the latest group' = eng so'nggi guruh.
⚠ 'the shore' = qirg'oq.

tasks.en: Jim was a fisherman, but during the summer he gave guided tours of the island. He used to tell the tourists exciting stories about a sea monster which lived off the coast of New Zealand.
tasks.uz: Jim baliqchi edi, lekin yozda orol bo'ylab gidli sayohatlar o'tkazardi. U turistlarga Yangi Zelandiya qirg'og'i yaqinida yashaydigan dengiz maxluqi haqida qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib berardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'USED TO tell' = aytib berardi (o'tmishdagi
odat).
⚠ 'off the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).

tasks.en: Of course, he had never seen it himself and didn't really believe it existed. Still, tourists enjoyed the story, and Jim hoped this would help to improve business.
tasks.uz: Albatta, u o'zi uni hech qachon ko'rmagan edi va mavjudligiga aslida ishonmasdi. Baribir turistlarga hikoya yoqardi va Jim bu biznesni yaxshilashga yordam beradi deb umid qilardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'he HAD never SEEN' - PAST PERFECT.
⚠ 'to exist' = mavjud bo'lmoq.
⚠ 'still' bu yerda = baribir, shunga qaramay.

tasks.en: Leaving the tourists on the beach to take some photographs and have lunch, Jim set off to do some fishing on his own for an hour. He stopped at his favourite quiet spot on the other side of the island and prepared his fishing rod. He was happy to be alone for a while.
tasks.uz: Turistlarni plyajda surat olish va tushlik qilish uchun qoldirib, Jim bir soatga yolg'iz baliq oviga jo'nadi. U orolning narigi tomonidagi sevimli tinch joyida to'xtab, qarmog'ini tayyorladi. Bir muddat yolg'iz qolganidan xursand edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to set off' = yo'lga chiqmoq, jo'namoq.
⚠ 'on his own' = yolg'iz o'zi.
⚠ 'for a while' = bir muddat.

tasks.en: He had just cast his fishing line into the water when the boat began rocking from side to side. Jim was surprised, then frightened. Suddenly, giant tentacles curled around the sides of the boat and lifted it out of the water.
tasks.uz: U qarmoq ipini suvga endigina tashlagan edi, qayiq u yoqdan-bu yoqqa chayqala boshladi. Jim hayron bo'ldi, keyin qo'rqib ketdi. To'satdan ulkan chodirlar qayiq atrofiga o'ralib, uni suvdan ko'tardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'HAD just CAST ... WHEN ...' - past perfect
+ past simple: birinchi voqea tugagan edi,
ikkinchisi boshlandi.
⚠ 'to rock from side to side' = chayqalmoq.
⚠ 'to curl around' = o'ralmoq.

tasks.en: "Help! A giant squid! Somebody help me!" Jim started screaming, but there was no one around.
tasks.uz: "Yordam! Ulkan kalmar! Kimdir yordam bering!" - Jim baqira boshladi, lekin atrofda hech kim yo'q edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to scream' = qichqirmoq.
⚠ 'there was no one around' = atrofda hech kim
yo'q edi.

tasks.en: Suddenly, a school of whales appeared in the distance. The squid let go of the boat and quickly disappeared. Jim couldn't believe what had happened. He looked at the water, then quickly started the boat engine.
tasks.uz: To'satdan uzoqda kitlar to'dasi paydo bo'ldi. Kalmar qayiqni qo'yib yubordi va tezda g'oyib bo'ldi. Jim nima bo'lganiga ishonolmasdi. U suvga qaradi, so'ng tezda qayiq motorini yoqdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'in the distance' = uzoqda.
⚠ 'to let go of' = qo'yib yubormoq.
⚠ 'what HAD HAPPENED' - past perfect.

tasks.en: When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened. Everybody started laughing, except for a middle aged woman. "You've just met Architeuthis, the giant squid!" she said.
tasks.uz: Plyajga yetib borgach, u turistlarga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi. Hamma kula boshladi, o'rta yoshli ayoldan tashqari. "Siz hozirgina Architeuthis - ulkan kalmarni uchratdingiz!" - dedi u.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'except for' = ... dan tashqari.
⚠ 'middle aged' = o'rta yoshli.
⚠ "You've just met" - present perfect + just.

tasks.en: She explained that she was a scientist who had spent most of her life in search of this squid. She was waiting for her colleagues to arrive. "Did you take any photographs?" she asked excitedly. "Of course not!" said Jim. "Who would take pictures at a time like that? I'm just glad I'm alive to tell the story."
tasks.uz: U hayotining ko'p qismini shu kalmarni qidirishga sarflagan olim ekanini tushuntirdi. U hamkasblarining kelishini kutayotgan edi. "Surat oldingizmi?" - deb so'radi u hayajon bilan. "Albatta yo'q! - dedi Jim. - Bunday paytda kim surat olardi? Hikoyani aytib berish uchun tirik qolganimdan xursandman".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'who HAD SPENT' - past perfect.
⚠ 'in search of' = ... ni qidirib.
⚠ 'a colleague' = hamkasb, /ˈkɒliːɡ/.
⚠ 'Who would take ...?' - ritorik savol.

tasks.en: The team of scientists searched for the giant squid for two months, but they found nothing. In the end, the only one who had benefitted from this was Jim. His guided tours became the most popular attraction on the island.
tasks.uz: Olimlar jamoasi ulkan kalmarni ikki oy qidirdi, lekin hech narsa topmadi. Oxir-oqibat, bundan foyda ko'rgan yagona odam Jim bo'ldi. Uning gidli sayohatlari oroldagi eng mashhur diqqatga sazovor joyga aylandi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat, nihoyat.
⚠ 'to benefit FROM' = ... dan foyda ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'who HAD BENEFITTED' - past perfect.

tasks.en: A Narrow Escape
tasks.uz: Arang qutulish

tasks.en: [D - 1] The early evening air was cool and mild as Ted Wilson walked along the almost-deserted beach. He wanted to be completely alone to think about his problems. Since he had lost his job, his life seemed to be full of problems.
tasks.uz: [D - 1] Ted Wilson deyarli kimsasiz plyaj bo'ylab yurganida kechki havo salqin va yumshoq edi. U muammolari haqida o'ylash uchun butunlay yolg'iz qolishni xohlardi. Ishini yo'qotganidan beri hayoti muammoga to'la tuyulardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'mild' = yumshoq, mo'tadil (ob-havo).
⚠ 'as' = ... paytida.
⚠ 'Since he HAD LOST' - past perfect.

tasks.en: [B - 2] Walking to the far end of the beach, Ted was so deep in thought that he didn't notice the dark clouds which had gathered overhead. When the first heavy drops of rain began to fall, he looked up in surprise and hurried back towards his car.
tasks.uz: [B - 2] Plyajning narigi chekkasiga yurar ekan, Ted shunchalik o'yga botgan ediki, tepasida to'plangan qora bulutlarni sezmadi. Yomg'irning birinchi yirik tomchilari tusha boshlaganda u hayron bo'lib yuqoriga qaradi va mashinasi tomon shoshildi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'so ... that' = shunchalik ... ki.
⚠ 'deep in thought' = o'yga botgan.
⚠ 'to gather' = to'planmoq; 'overhead' = tepada.

tasks.en: [A - 3] The soft dry sand of the beach slowed him down, so he started running on the hard sand at the water's edge. Before he had gone fifty metres, though, he suddenly felt himself sinking into the sand. Within seconds, he had sunk in up to his waist.
tasks.uz: [A - 3] Plyajning yumshoq quruq qumi uni sekinlashtirardi, shuning uchun u suv chekkasidagi qattiq qumda yugura boshladi. Lekin ellik metr yurmasidan to'satdan qumga botayotganini sezdi. Bir necha soniyada beligacha botgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to slow sb down' = sekinlashtirmoq.
⚠ "the water's edge" = suv chekkasi.
⚠ 'within seconds' = bir necha soniyada.
⚠ 'up to his waist' = beligacha.

tasks.en: He realised to his horror that he had stepped into quicksand. When he tried to move, the sand pulled him deeper - and the tide was coming in! The water soon covered his chest, and continued to rise. "Help!" he shouted desperately. "Help! I'm going to drown!"
tasks.uz: U dahshat bilan botqoq qumga qadam qo'yganini angladi. Qimirlamoqchi bo'lganida qum uni chuqurroq tortdi - suv esa ko'tarilayotgan edi! Suv tez orada ko'kragini qopladi va ko'tarilishda davom etdi. "Yordam! - deb qichqirdi u umidsizlik bilan. - Yordam! Cho'kib ketaman!"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to his horror' = dahshat bilan.
⚠ 'chest' = ko'krak.
⚠ 'desperately' = umidsizlik bilan.
⚠ "I'm going to drown" - ko'rib turgan dalil
asosida taxmin.

tasks.en: [E - 4] Steve MacDonald was looking for shells at the other end of the beach when he heard Ted's cries. By the time Steve reached him, the water was up to Ted's chin and he was in real danger. Steve grabbed his arms, pulled him out of the quicksand and helped him to safety.
tasks.uz: [E - 4] Steve MacDonald plyajning narigi chekkasida chig'anoqlar qidirayotgan edi, Tedning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi. Steve yetib borgan paytga kelib suv Tedning iyagigacha chiqqan va u haqiqiy xavfda edi. Steve uning qo'llaridan ushlab, botqoq qumdan tortib chiqardi va xavfsiz joyga olib bordi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'WAS LOOKING ... WHEN he HEARD' - past
continuous + past simple.
⚠ 'chin' = iyak.
⚠ 'to grab' = ushlab olmoq.

tasks.en: Ted was so relieved to have escaped that he couldn't say a word. He shook Steve's hand, again and again, in silent thanks.
tasks.uz: Ted qutulganidan shunchalik yengil tortgan ediki, bir og'iz so'z aytolmadi. U jim minnatdorchilik bilan Stevening qo'lini qayta-qayta siqdi.

tasks.en: [C - 5] After what had happened, Ted realised that losing a job wasn't the worst thing that could happen to someone. He was glad to be alive, and felt sure that everything would be all right in the end.
tasks.uz: [C - 5] Bo'lib o'tgan voqeadan keyin Ted ishni yo'qotish odam boshiga tushishi mumkin bo'lgan eng yomon narsa emasligini angladi. U tirikligidan xursand edi va oxir-oqibat hammasi yaxshi bo'lishiga ishonardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'losING a job' - gerund ega vazifasida.
⚠ 'the worst' = eng yomon.
⚠ 'would be' - o'tmishdagi kelajak.

tasks.en: [c] It was a cold, cloudy morning in October and Pam Brown was on her way to the supermarket. It had rained earlier, so the pavements were wet and slippery.
tasks.uz: [c] Oktyabrning sovuq, bulutli tongi edi va Pam Braun supermarketga ketayotgan edi. Avvalroq yomg'ir yog'gan edi, shuning uchun yo'laklar ho'l va sirpanchiq edi.

⚠ 1-XATBOShI: boshlanish (qachon, kim, qayerda, ob-havo).
⚠ 'It had rained earlier' - oldingi holat.

tasks.en: [d] Pam walked past all the expensive shops. She stopped in front of VanBurg Jewellers and admired the magnificent jewellery in the window. It had always been Pam's dream to own a diamond necklace. Suddenly, a man wearing a mask and carrying a bag ran out of the shop. Another man rushed out after him, shouting, "Stop that thief! Stop him!"
tasks.uz: [d] Pam barcha qimmat do'konlar yonidan o'tdi. U VanBurg zargarlik do'koni oldida to'xtab, vitrinadagi ajoyib taqinchoqlarni tomosha qildi. Olmos marjonga ega bo'lish har doim Pamning orzusi edi. To'satdan niqob kiygan va sumka ko'targan bir odam do'kondan yugurib chiqdi. Boshqa bir odam uning orqasidan otilib chiqib qichqirdi: "O'g'rini to'xtating! Uni to'xtating!"
tasks.note:
⚠ 2-XATBOShI: voqea boshlanishi.
⚠ 'It had always been Pam's dream' - 2-savol javobi.

tasks.en: [a] Pam screamed when she saw the man running past her. Suddenly he slipped on the wet pavement and fell to the ground. Pam quickly picked up the bag that had fallen from the man's hand and pulled off his mask. At that moment the police arrived.
tasks.uz: [a] Pam odam yonidan yugurib o'tayotganini ko'rib qichqirdi. To'satdan u ho'l yo'lakda sirpanib yerga yiqildi. Pam tezda odamning qo'lidan tushib ketgan sumkani oldi va niqobini yechdi. Shu payt politsiya yetib keldi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 3-XATBOShI: kulminatsiya.
⚠ 3-savol javobi: sumkani oldi, niqobini yechdi.

tasks.en: [b] Three hours later, Pam was walking home when a man stopped her. It was the man she had seen chasing the thief out of the shop. "Miss Brown? I'm Hans VanBurg. I just wanted to thank you for your bravery," he said. "Here, this is for you." He handed Pam a small velvet case. Inside it was a beautiful diamond necklace. "Oh, my goodness!" Pam said with a delighted smile on her face. "Dreams really can come true!"
tasks.uz: [b] Uch soatdan keyin Pam uyga ketayotganida bir odam uni to'xtatdi. Bu o'g'rini do'kondan quvib chiqqanini ko'rgan o'sha odam edi. "Miss Braun? Men Hans VanBurgman. Jasoratingiz uchun rahmat aytmoqchi edim," dedi u. "Mana, bu siz uchun." U Pamga kichik baxmal quti uzatdi. Ichida go'zal olmos marjon bor edi. "Voy, xudoyim!" dedi Pam yuzida xursand tabassum bilan. "Orzular chindan ham ro'yobga chiqar ekan!"
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-XATBOShI: yakun va his-tuyg'ular.
⚠ 4-5-savollar javobi: Hans VanBurg (do'kon egasi), Pam xursand (delighted).

exercises.instructionEn: We use the past perfect simple for an action which happened in the past before another past action. The action which happened earlier is in the past perfect simple, and the action which happened later is in the past simple. We also use it as the past equivalent of the present perfect simple: the past perfect simple for an action which started and finished in the past; the present perfect simple for an action which started in the past and finished in the present. Greg wasn't at home. He had gone out. (Greg was out then.) Greg isn't at home. He has gone out. (Greg is out now.) Time expressions: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before, etc. Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple: past continuous - a past action in progress when it was interrupted by another action: He was watching TV when the phone rang. Past perfect simple - a past action which happened before another past action: They had booked a room before they went on holiday.
exercises.instructionUz: Past perfect simple o'tmishda BOShQA O'TGAN HARAKATDAN OLDIN bo'lgan harakat uchun ishlatiladi. OLDINROQ bo'lgan harakat - past perfect simple, KEYINROQ bo'lgan harakat - past simple. Shuningdek, present perfect ning o'tmishdagi muqobili sifatida: past perfect - o'tmishda boshlanib o'tmishda tugagan harakat; present perfect - o'tmishda boshlanib hozir tugagan harakat. Greg uyda emas edi. U chiqib ketgan edi. (Greg o'shanda tashqarida edi.) Greg uyda emas. U chiqib ketgan. (Greg hozir tashqarida.) Vaqt so'zlari: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before. Past Continuous va Past Perfect farqi: past continuous - boshqa harakat uzganda davom etayotgan o'tgan harakat: Telefon jiringlaganda u televizor ko'rayotgan edi. Past perfect - boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldin bo'lgan harakat: Ta'tilga chiqishdan oldin ular xona band qilgan edi.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT QAChON:

  1) O'TMIShDA IKKI HARAKAT -
     OLDINGISI:
     OLDIN → Past Perfect (had V3)
     KEYIN → Past Simple (V2)
     They HAD BOOKED a room before
     they WENT on holiday.
     (avval band qildi, keyin
     ketdi)

  2) PRESENT PERFECT NING O'TMIShI:
     Greg ISN'T at home. He HAS
     GONE out. (hozir yo'q)
     Greg WASN'T at home. He HAD
     GONE out. (o'shanda yo'q edi)


VAQT SO'ZLARI:

  already, by the time (... gacha),
  never, as soon as, just, after,
  when, before


PAST CONTINUOUS va PAST PERFECT:

  CONTINUOUS - davom etayotgan
    harakat UZILDI:
    He WAS WATCHING TV when the
    phone RANG. (bir vaqtda)

  PERFECT - bir harakat ikkinchi-
    sidan OLDIN TUGADI:
    They HAD BOOKED a room before
    they WENT. (ketma-ket)


⚠ 'BY THE TIME':

  = ... vaqtiga kelib, ... gacha.

exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT - 8-UNITNING ASOSIY
GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAD + 3-ShAKL (past participle)
  ⚠ BARCha shaxsda 'had' - o'zgarmaydi!

  TASDIQ: I/he/they HAD eaten
  INKOR: HADN'T eaten (had not)
  SAVOL: HAD you eaten?
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, I had. /
     No, I hadn't.

  QISQARTMA: I'd, he'd, they'd
  ⚠ "I'd" = 'I had' (past perfect)
  yoki 'I would' - kontekstga qarab:
  "I'd eaten" → had; "I'd like" →
  would.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  O'TMIShDA IKKI VOQEA - qaysi biri
  OLDIN bo'lganini ko'rsatadi:

  'He called Jane AFTER he HAD
   FINISHED dinner.'
  1-voqea: finished dinner (past
     perfect - OLDINGISI)
  2-voqea: called Jane (past
     simple - KEYINGISI)

  ⚠ "O'tmishdan ham oldingi o'tmish"
  deb eslab qoling.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRESENT PERFECT BILAN ALOQASI   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  present perfect: has/have + 3-shakl
     'He HAS never travelled abroad.'
     (hozirgacha)
  past perfect: had + 3-shakl
     'He HAD never travelled abroad.'
     (o'tmishdagi biror paytgacha)

  ⚠ Past perfect = present perfect
  ning O'TGAN ZAMONI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VAQT SO'ZLARI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  already, by the time, never,
  as soon as, just, after, when,
  before

  ⚠ 'by the time' = ... gacha,
  ... paytga kelib.
  ⚠ 'as soon as' = ... zahoti.


⚠ 'BEFORE' va 'AFTER' BILAN:

  'AFTER he HAD finished, he
   called.' (after + past perfect)
  'BEFORE he called, he HAD
   finished.' (before + past simple,
   asosiy gap past perfect)


⚠ 'EQUIVALENT':

  = ekvivalent, teng.
  ⚠ 'the past equivalent of' =
  ... ning o'tgan zamondagi tengi.

    (avval tozaladi, keyin Bill

  2 She HAD NEVER EATEN Thai food

    before they CAME back.

  asosiy gapda PAST PERFECT.


⚠ 'AFTER' bilan:

  AFTER X HAD happened, Y happened.
  ⚠ 'after' dan keyin PAST PERFECT.

  = uyga kelmoq (mehmonga).


⚠ 'A PLAY':

  = spektakl (teatr).
  ⚠ 'to watch a play' = spektakl
  ko'rmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SURAT, IKKI ZAMON.

  A: 'They WERE COOKING dinner at 7
     o'clock yesterday.'
     → PAST CONTINUOUS - kecha soat
       7 da JARAYoNDA edi (surat:
       pishirishyapti)

  B: 'They HAD COOKED dinner before
     their guests arrived.'
     → PAST PERFECT - mehmonlar
       kelishidan OLDIN TUGAGAN
       (surat: ovqat tayyor, stolda)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAST CONTINUOUS vs PAST PERFECT ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  PAST CONTINUOUS (was/were + -ing):
    o'tmishdagi ANIQ VAQTDA DAVOM
    ETAYoTGAN harakat
    'at 7 o'clock', 'when I came in'

  PAST PERFECT (had + 3-shakl):
    boshqa voqeadan OLDIN TUGAGAN
    harakat
    'before the guests arrived'


⚠ TAQQOSLASh:

  'When I arrived, they WERE HAVING
   dinner.' - men kelganimda
   ovqatlanishayotgan edi (jarayon)
  'When I arrived, they HAD HAD
   dinner.' - men kelganimda
   ovqatlanib bo'lgan edi (tugagan)


⚠ 'IN PROGRESS':

  = jarayonda, davom etayotgan.

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past perfect simple shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE yoki PAST PERFECT?

  ⚠ Gapdagi IKKINChI fe'lga
  qarang: agar u past simple bo'lsa
  (phoned, started, woke up ...),
  OLDINGI ish → PAST PERFECT.
  Agar u past perfect bo'lsa (had
  taken, had landed ...), KEYINGI
  ish → PAST SIMPLE.

  1 had returned (by the time ...
    phoned)
  2 didn't go (until she had taken)
  3 had watered (after ... started)
  4 turned off (as soon as ... had
    landed)
  5 had already made (by the time
    ... woke up)
  6 washed (after ... had gone)
  7 had never seen (before ... went)
  8 rang (had just finished when)
  9 had taken (until - oldin)
  10 had gone (by the time ...
     completed)
  11 didn't want (as she had seen)
  12 locked (as soon as ... had left)
  13 had already had (so ... didn't
     need)
  14 had cut (because - sabab oldin)


⚠ 'BY THE TIME':

  = ... gacha, ... paytga kelib.
  Deyarli har doim + past perfect.


⚠ 'TO WATER THE PLANTS':

  = o'simliklarni sug'ormoq.


⚠ 'THE SEAT-BELT SIGN':

  = xavfsizlik kamari belgisi
  (samolyotda).

tasks.en: When we write a story narrating a frightening experience we can divide our composition into five paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Qo'rqinchli voqea haqida hikoya yozganda inshoni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we set the scene. We write about who was involved in the story, when and where it happened, and what happened first.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida sahnani o'rnatamiz. Hikoyada kim ishtirok etgani, qachon va qayerda bo'lgani, birinchi nima bo'lgani haqida yozamiz.

tasks.en: We continue in the second, third and fourth paragraphs, writing the events in the order they happened.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi, uchinchi va to'rtinchi xatboshilarda voqealarni bo'lgan tartibda yozib davom etamiz.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph, we write what happened in the end and how the people in the story felt.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida oxirida nima bo'lgani va hikoyadagi odamlar nima his qilganini yozamiz.

tasks.en: We normally use past tenses in such pieces of writing.
tasks.uz: Bunday yozuvlarda odatda o'tgan zamonlarni ishlatamiz.

tasks.en: Bob and Ian were experienced climbers. One cold winter day, they were climbing a steep, dangerous mountain when they stopped to rest in a small cave.

tasks.en: They lit a small stove and started making some instant soup. Suddenly, they heard a rumbling noise, and snow and ice began to fall outside.
tasks.uz: Ular kichik pechka yoqib, tez tayyor sho'rva pishira boshlashdi. To'satdan gumburlagan ovoz eshitildi va tashqarida qor va muz tusha boshladi.

tasks.en: Within seconds, the snow had blocked the entrance to the cave and they were trapped inside. It was freezing cold and they were very scared, so they radioed for help.

tasks.en: Three hours later, the rescuers arrived. It took them six hours to dig the two men out. The rescuers explained that there had been a small avalanche.

tasks.en: A helicopter took Bob and Ian to the Rescue Centre. When the rescuers asked them if they were going to give up climbing, Ian said, "No - but we're never going into caves again!"

tasks.en:
My Feathered Hero

It was a hot summer morning in the Amazon Rainforest. Nigel James, an explorer, was having breakfast outside his hut with his parrot, Polly. The sun was shining and the birds were singing.

After he had finished his breakfast, Nigel decided to go for a walk in the forest. He put on his hat and set off. Polly followed him, flying from tree to tree.

Suddenly, Nigel saw a dangerous snake in front of him. He stood still. He was terrified! Just then, Polly flew down, picked up the snake in her beak and dropped it from high above. The snake disappeared into the trees.

Nigel felt very relieved. "You saved my life, my friend," he said to Polly. From that day on, Nigel never went anywhere without his feathered hero.
tasks.uz:
Mening patli qahramonim

Amazonka tropik o'rmonida issiq yoz tongi edi. Sayyoh Nigel Jeyms to'tiqushi Polli bilan kulbasi oldida nonushta qilayotgan edi. Quyosh porlab, qushlar sayrayotgan edi.

Nonushtasini tugatgach, Nigel o'rmonda sayr qilishga qaror qildi. U shlyapasini kiyib yo'lga chiqdi. Polli daraxtdan daraxtga uchib unga ergashdi.

To'satdan Nigel oldida xavfli ilonni ko'rdi. U qimirlamay turdi. U dahshatga tushgan edi! Shu payt Polli pastga uchib kelib, ilonni tumshug'iga oldi va balanddan tashladi. Ilon daraxtlar orasiga g'oyib bo'ldi.

Nigel juda yengil tortdi. "Sen hayotimni saqlab qolding, do'stim," dedi u Polliga. O'sha kundan boshlab Nigel patli qahramonisiz hech qayerga bormaydigan bo'ldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: In picture [X] there is [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In picture A there is a squid and a school of whales.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: A-suratda kalmar va kitlar to'dasi bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: When [ega] + PAST SIMPLE, [ega] + PAST SIMPLE + what had happened.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When he reached the beach, he told the tourists what had happened.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Plyajga yetib borgach, u turistlarga nima bo'lganini aytib berdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'had happened' - PAST PERFECT: aytishdan
OLDIN bo'lgan voqea (8-unit mavzusi).

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] used to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He used to tell the tourists exciting stories.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U turistlarga qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib berardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] had just + 3-ShAKL when [voqea].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He had just cast his fishing line when the boat began rocking.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qarmoq ipini endigina tashlagan edi, qayiq chayqala boshladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PAST PERFECT + when + PAST SIMPLE: birinchi
voqea tugagan, ikkinchisi boshlandi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] couldn't believe what had happened.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jim couldn't believe what had happened.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jim nima bo'lganiga ishonolmasdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Everybody + PAST SIMPLE, except for [kim].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Everybody started laughing, except for a middle aged woman.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hamma kula boshladi, o'rta yoshli ayoldan tashqari.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] + PAST SIMPLE after [ega] had + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He called Jane after he had finished dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kechki ovqatni tugatgandan keyin Jeynga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] had + 3-ShAKL before [ega] + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She had never eaten Thai food before she went to Thailand.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Tailandga borishdan oldin hech qachon tailand taomini yemagan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'before' + past simple; asosiy gap past
perfect.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] had just + 3-ShAKL when [voqea].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I had just finished the cleaning when Bill came round.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tozalashni endigina tugatgan edim, Bill keldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Had [ega] + 3-ShAKL? - Yes, she had. / No, she hadn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Had she done the laundry? - No, she hadn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kir yuvib bo'lganmidi? - Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Past perfect savol va qisqa javob.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] had already + 3-ShAKL by the time [voqea].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The train had already left by the time we arrived at the station.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz bekatga yetib borgan paytga kelib poyezd allaqachon ketgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'by the time' + past simple; asosiy gap past
perfect.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] + PAST SIMPLE as soon as [ega] had + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paula went to bed as soon as her guests had left.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mehmonlari ketishi bilanoq Paula uxlashga yotdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When [voqea], [ega] was/were + -ING. (jarayon)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When Cath got home, her daughters were waiting for her.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Cath uyga kelganida qizlari uni kutayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When [voqea], [ega] had + 3-ShAKL. (tugagan)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When we returned, the hurricane had destroyed our house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qaytganimizda dovul uyimizni vayron qilgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] was so + SIFAT that [natija].

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ted shunchalik o'yga botgan ediki, qora bulutlarni sezmadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] was + -ING when [ega] + PAST SIMPLE.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Steve was looking for shells when he heard Ted's cries.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Steve chig'anoq qidirayotgan edi, Tedning qichqiriqlarini eshitdi.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Steve yetib borgan paytga kelib suv Tedning iyagigacha chiqqan edi.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ishini yo'qotganidan beri hayoti muammoga to'la tuyulardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm afraid I can't [fe'l]. I haven't [3-ShAKL] ... yet. - Don't worry about it.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Afsuski, idishlarga yordam berolmayman. Hali uy vazifamni tugatmadim. - Xavotir olma.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] were + -ING when [ega] + PAST SIMPLE.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular tik toqqa chiqayotgan edilar, g'orda dam olish uchun to'xtashdi.
